description: Google apps and common carrier and social preloads found on many brands.

packages.name: Facebook
packages.what: The Facebook app, preinstalled by the phone maker.
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Facebook App Manager
packages.what: Updates preinstalled Facebook apps in the background.
packages.breaks: Preinstalled Facebook apps stop updating themselves outside the Play Store.

packages.name: Facebook App Installer
packages.what: Installs and updates Facebook apps in the background.
packages.breaks: Preinstalled Facebook apps stop updating themselves outside the Play Store.

packages.name: Facebook Services
packages.what: Background helper for preinstalled Facebook apps.
packages.breaks: Nothing outside Facebook's own apps.

packages.name: Instagram
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Netflix
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Netflix activation helper
packages.what: Tells Netflix this phone came with it preinstalled.
packages.breaks: Nothing you would notice.

packages.name: LinkedIn
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Spotify
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Snapchat
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: TikTok
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: TikTok
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Amazon Shopping
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Amazon app helper
packages.breaks: Nothing you would notice.

packages.name: Microsoft 365
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Link to Windows
packages.what: Connects the phone to a Windows PC.
packages.breaks: Phone Link on your Windows PC stops working.

packages.name: OneDrive
packages.breaks: OneDrive stops. On Samsung phones, Gallery cloud sync uses OneDrive and stops too.

packages.name: YouTube
packages.breaks: YouTube links open in the web browser instead.

packages.name: YouTube Music
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: YouTube Kids
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google TV
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google Play Music
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google News
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google Podcasts
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google Play Books
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google Keep
packages.breaks: Keep notes are not shown on the phone (they stay in your Google account).

packages.name: Calculator
packages.breaks: No calculator unless another one is installed.

packages.name: Google One
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Google Home
packages.breaks: You cannot set up or control Chromecast and Nest devices from this phone.

packages.name: Assistant shortcut
packages.what: A home-screen icon for Google Assistant.
packages.breaks: Only the icon goes; Assistant itself is part of the Google app.

packages.name: Print service recommendations
packages.breaks: No printer plug-in suggestions when printing.

packages.name: Google Meet
packages.breaks: Video-call buttons in the phone and contacts apps stop working.

packages.name: Google Drive
packages.breaks: Drive files cannot be opened on the phone; some apps' 'save to Drive' stops.

packages.name: Google Photos
packages.breaks: Photo backup stops. On some phones this is the only gallery app.

packages.name: Gmail
packages.breaks: No Gmail notifications. On some phones this is the only email app.

packages.name: Google Maps
packages.breaks: No navigation; map links and location sharing in other apps stop working.

packages.name: Google Calendar
packages.breaks: No event reminders unless another calendar app is installed.

packages.name: Google Contacts
packages.breaks: You cannot browse or edit contacts unless another contacts app is installed.

packages.name: Clock
packages.breaks: Alarms you have set will not ring.

packages.name: Google Wallet
packages.breaks: Paying by tapping the phone stops working.

packages.name: Google Pay
packages.breaks: Payments through Google Pay stop working.

packages.name: Digital Wellbeing
packages.what: Screen-time tools, Bedtime mode, Focus mode.
packages.breaks: App timers, Bedtime mode and Focus mode stop; the Settings entry breaks.

packages.name: Google feedback agent
packages.what: Sends crash and feedback reports to Google.
packages.breaks: 'Send feedback' buttons in Google apps may do nothing.

packages.name: Android Auto
packages.what: Shows the phone on a car screen.
packages.breaks: Android Auto in your car stops working.

packages.name: Speech Services by Google
packages.what: Reads text aloud and powers voice typing in some apps.
packages.breaks: Spoken navigation, read-aloud and TalkBack lose their voice.

packages.name: Android Accessibility Suite
packages.what: TalkBack screen reader and other accessibility tools.
packages.breaks: TalkBack, Select to Speak and Switch Access are unavailable.

packages.name: Chrome
packages.breaks: Links may have no browser to open in; some app sign-in screens use Chrome.

packages.name: Data transfer tool
packages.what: Copies data from an old phone during setup.
packages.breaks: Restoring from a backup or old phone will not work until switched back on.

packages.name: Google Play Services for AR
packages.breaks: AR features in the camera and other apps stop working.

packages.name: Google app
packages.what: Search, Assistant, Discover feed, Lens, voice typing.
packages.breaks: Assistant, the home-screen search bar, the Discover feed and Lens stop; some launchers misbehave.

packages.name: Gboard
packages.breaks: If this is your only keyboard you cannot type, including your screen-lock password.

packages.name: Google Messages
packages.breaks: You may be unable to send or read text messages.

packages.name: Phone by Google
packages.breaks: You may be unable to make or answer calls.

packages.name: Device Health Services
packages.breaks: Battery predictions and adaptive battery stop working.

packages.name: Android System Intelligence
packages.what: Smart text selection, Live Caption, Now Playing.
packages.breaks: Several smart features stop; some phones show errors.

packages.name: Private Compute Services
packages.breaks: Smart features that depend on it stop working.

packages.name: My Verizon
packages.breaks: You cannot manage your Verizon account from the app; visual voicemail setup may be affected.

packages.name: T-Mobile
packages.breaks: You cannot manage your T-Mobile account from the app.

packages.name: Android Easter egg
packages.what: The hidden game behind tapping the Android version.
packages.breaks: The Easter egg no longer opens.

packages.name: Basic screensavers
packages.breaks: Those screensavers are unavailable.

packages.name: Photo screensavers
packages.breaks: Those screensavers are unavailable.

packages.name: Bookmark store
packages.what: Old shared store for browser bookmarks.
packages.breaks: Nothing on current phones.

packages.name: System Tracing
packages.what: A developer tool for recording performance traces.
packages.breaks: Developers cannot record system traces.

packages.name: Live wallpaper picker
packages.breaks: You cannot pick live wallpapers.

packages.name: Print spooler
packages.breaks: Printing from the phone stops working.

packages.name: Default print service
packages.what: Finds and prints to Wi-Fi printers.
packages.breaks: Printing to Wi-Fi printers stops working.

packages.name: HTML viewer
packages.what: Shows simple web pages such as licence screens.
packages.breaks: Some help and licence screens will not open.

packages.name: Call log backup
packages.what: Includes your call history in Google backups.
packages.breaks: Call history is no longer backed up.

packages.name: Equaliser
packages.breaks: Equaliser settings in music apps may not open.
